title: Reliable and explainable analysis of AVS/RS by Statistical Model Checking and Process Mining
abstract: arXiv:2611.14371v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated Vehicle Storage and Retrieval Systems (AVS/RS) are increasingly adopted to boost warehouse throughput while containing operational costs. We present an integrated analysis framework that couples discrete-event simulation with Statistical Model Checking (SMC) and Process Mining (PM) to quantify and explain AVS/RS performance. SMC, implemented through the MultiVeStA tool, delivers statistically reliable estimates of key indicators, such as cycle times, throughput, and storage utilization, across alternative stocking and picking policies with user-specified confidence levels. MultiVeStA orchestrates multiple independent simulations in a black-box manner, enabling automated verification. PM ingests the resulting event logs to uncover the behavioral patterns and bottlenecks that drive those indicators, closing the interpretability gap typical of simulation studies. translated_title: 基于统计模型检验与过程挖掘的自动化车辆存取系统（AVS/RS）的可靠且可解释的分析
translated_abstract: 自动化车辆存取系统（AVS/RS）日益被广泛采用，以在控制运营成本的同时提升仓库吞吐量。我们提出了一个集成分析框架，将离散事件仿真与统计模型检验（SMC）和过程挖掘（PM）相结合，以量化和解释AVS/RS的性能。通过MultiVeStA工具实现的SMC，能够在用户指定的置信水平下，针对不同的存储和拣选策略，对周期时间、吞吐量和存储利用率等关键指标提供统计上可靠的估计。MultiVeStA以黑盒方式协调多次独立仿真，实现自动化验证。过程挖掘（PM）通过分析产生的事件日志，揭示驱动这些指标的行为模式和瓶颈，从而弥补了仿真研究中典型的可解释性缺口。我们在一个新的开源AVS/RS仿真器上实例化了该框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一个将离散事件仿真、统计模型检验（SMC）与过程挖掘（PM）相结合的集成分析框架，既能以统计可靠的方式量化自动化车辆存取系统（AVS/RS）的关键性能指标，又能解释其背后的行为模式与瓶颈，填补了仿真研究中的可解释性空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an integrated framework combining discrete-event simulation, Statistical Model Checking, and Process Mining to reliably quantify and explain the performance of Automated Vehicle Storage and Retrieval Systems (AVS/RS), bridging the interpretability gap of simulation studies.
